name: TKO Group Holdings, Inc.
moat_justification: UFC and WWE are irreplaceable category-defining sports IP with multi-year contracted media-rights step-ups already signed for 2026 onward (Paramount, ESPN, Netflix), an asset-light cost base, and brand-over-athlete fan loyalty - a strong moat. It is not a 9-10: rights pricing power is only re-proven at renewal, litigation (fighter pay, shareholder suits) is a recurring tax, the IMG/On Location segment is lower-margin and event-cyclical, and leverage plus the noncontrolling-interest structure sit ahead of Class A economics.
fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 9 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
DILUTION: share count growing 53.0%/yr — already deducted via the growth adjustment; check SBC trend
BASIS_BREAK_SUSPECT: a >60% revenue jump/drop in the last 5 yrs — check for divestitures, big M&A, or restatements before trusting any CAGR
OE_VOLATILE: OE/share range over the last 5 yrs spans >3x — normalized base helps but the business is cyclical; widen bear weight
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2023, 2024, 2025 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base

OVERRIDE_APPLIED:capex — filing gap in the last 3 FY filled by a judgment override (filing: Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (filed 2026-02-25, accession 0001193125-26-071651), Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows, investing activities line 'Purchases of property, buildings and equipment and other assets': $(126,953) thousand for FY2025, with $(118,818) thousand for FY2024 and $(93,753) thousand for FY2023 in the same statement. The line is tagged in the filing's inline XBRL only under TKO's extension tag tko:PaymentsToAcquirePropertyPlantAndEquipmentAndOther, which EDGAR companyfacts does not carry (CIK 1973266 facts contain only us-gaap/dei/ecd namespaces and no standard capex tag), so the engine filed no capex value for any period. Corroborated in the Q2 2026 Form 10-Q (accession 0001193125-26-330592), same line: $(44,444) thousand for H1 2026 vs $(48,631) thousand for H1 2025.); an override never replaces a filed value — see overrides_applied and override_impact
BASE_DIVERGENCE: latest FY OE/share 5.37 vs 3-yr median 2.07 — one of them is distorted; find out which and why
one_liner: Elite sports-IP owner, moat 7/10 - but at $172.85 the price already pays for the new rights deals: weighted IRR 9.45% (Tier D), weighted IV@15% $91.05 vs $172.85; it clears 15% only at or below $91.05, and even the super-bull case (14.81% IRR) does not clear at today's price.
moat_for: UFC and WWE are the category-defining properties in MMA and sports entertainment - no substitute supplier at scale
Long-term contracted media rights with step-ups: UFC on Paramount (7 years from 2026), WWE premium live events on ESPN (5 years from 2026), Raw on Netflix
Asset-light model: venues are rented, capex is ~2.7% of revenue, and ticketing/hospitality/sponsorship carry premium pricing
Fans follow the promotion brand over individual fighters/talent, and promoter-favorable talent economics hold through cycles
moat_against: Media-rights pricing power is only proven at renewal; current deals are long but back-end weighted
Litigation overhang: fighter-pay/antitrust history and WWE shareholder litigation (settlement costs hit Q2 2026 SG&A)
IMG/On Location is lower-margin and event-cyclical (World Cup/Olympics years), diluting the core moat
Net debt $2.931B and a large noncontrolling-interest share of OpCo economics
Ticketing/hospitality demand is consumer-discretionary and cyclical

The line is tagged in the filing's inline XBRL only under TKO's extension tag tko:PaymentsToAcquirePropertyPlantAndEquipmentAndOther, which EDGAR companyfacts does not carry (CIK 1973266 facts contain only us-gaap/dei/ecd namespaces and no standard capex tag), so the engine filed no capex value for any period. Corroborated in the Q2 2026 Form 10-Q (accession 0001193125-26-330592), same line: $(44,444) thousand for H1 2026 vs $(48,631) thousand for H1 2025.
